hints.content:
The point $(3,-3)$ does *not* lie in the shaded area of the inequalities.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane with a graphed system of inequalities. The x- and y-axes both scale by one. There is a dashed line representing an inequality that goes through the points zero, negative one and one, one. The shaded region for the inequality is above the line. There is another dashed line representing the second inequality that goes through the points zero, two and five, five. The shaded region for this inequality is above the line. The point three, negative three is plotted outside of both shaded regions.

hints.content: No, $(3,-3)$ is not a solution of the system of inequalities.
